title: Household tax credit

ask.paysForHouseholdWork: Do you pay for cleaning, care or renovation work at home?

message: In {firstYear} and {lastYear}, qualifying company labour including VAT can give a {rate} % credit against tax, less a {ownShare} € annual own liability, up to {max} € per person per year. Not materials, travel or a guaranteed refund.
_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
explain: In {firstYear} and {lastYear}, qualifying company labour including VAT can give a {rate} % credit against tax, less a {ownShare} € annual own liability, up to {max} € per person per year. The work must qualify and the company must be in the prepayment register. Materials and travel do not qualify. The employee and oil-heating replacement routes differ. The credit reduces tax, not taxable income, and is limited by tax available. Never assume all invoice costs qualify.
